festivals.what: Nachi no Ogi Matsuri (Nachi Fire Festival), the annual grand festival of Kumano Nachi Taisha: 14 July every year, with 12 fan-shaped portable shrines; preparation rites on 9, 11 and 13 July.

layers.process: The Ohechi Route of the Kumano Kodo is closed between Wabuka Station and Tako Station from 8 June 2026 to an estimated 30 April 2027, because of expressway construction. The bureau's notice of 31 May 2026 says to bypass this section by train or bus. A notice of 25 February 2026 says booking requests are taken only from 7:00 to 9:30 and 19:00 to 22:00 JST each day.

laws.rule: Wakayama Youth Healthy Development Ordinance (和歌山県青少年健全育成条例), art. 22 (the ordinance says "night", 夜間). The ordinance sets the late-night period as 10 pm to 4 am. A guardian must try not to let a young person (generally under 18) go out in that period without special reason; the guardian's own duty has no penalty. Anyone else is barred from taking such a young person out, going about with them or keeping them out in that period without the guardian's consent or another proper reason. The offence for others carries a fine of up to JPY 300,000 (about A$2,707). Rates: RBA 30 Oct 2026, A$1 = JPY 110.82.
